text: On Sunday evening, Aziz wants to save a pair of running shoes in the marketplace, on his laptop.
prefix: On Sunday evening, Aziz wants to save a pair of running shoes in the marketplace, on his laptop.

text: The web page asks for his phone number.
prefix: The web page asks for his phone number.

text: Nothing more.
prefix: Nothing more.

text: So what happens between that phone number and a customer who can use every app of the bank?
prefix: So what happens between that phone number and a customer who can use every app of the bank?

text: In Lesson 9, the apps learned to call the heeyID API through its contract, and only the master app got the MyID and TAF parts.
prefix: In Lesson 9, the apps learned to call the heeyID API through its contract, and only the master app got the MyID and TAF parts.

text: This lesson follows the first call of that contract: the registration, from a phone number to level one.
prefix: This lesson follows the first call of that contract: the registration, from a phone number to level one.

text: Aziz types his number and taps Continue.
prefix: Aziz types his number and taps Continue.

text: The marketplace sends the app, the number, the language of the journey and a short description of the device.
prefix: The marketplace sends the app, the number, the language of the journey and a short description of the device.

text: The request also carries its network address.
prefix: The request also carries its network address.

text: The platform checks three facts.
prefix: The platform checks three facts.

text: The number is a real mobile number of Uzbekistan.
prefix: The number is a real mobile number of Uzbekistan.

text: The app is active.
prefix: The app is active.

text: And no limit is reached, which is the subject of Lesson 11.
prefix: And no limit is reached, which is the subject of Lesson 11.

text: Then the platform opens a registration record, in the state Started.
prefix: Then the platform opens a registration record, in the state Started.

text: From now on, every text and every code message to Aziz is in his language.
prefix: From now on, every text and every code message to Aziz is in his language.

text: Next, the platform makes a one-time code.
prefix: Next, the platform makes a one-time code.

text: The code is random.
prefix: The code is random.

text: It never comes from the number, the time or the device.
prefix: It never comes from the number, the time or the device.

text: The platform keeps it only as a digest, so even the database cannot say the code back.
prefix: The platform keeps it only as a digest, so even the database cannot say the code back.

text: The marketplace gets the lifetime of the code and the number of resends that remain.
prefix: The marketplace gets the lifetime of the code and the number of resends that remain.

text: It never gets the code.
prefix: It never gets the code.

text: Who sends the SMS?
prefix: Who sends the SMS?

text: Here the app decides.
prefix: Here the app decides.

text: The marketplace web profile is a side app, and side apps do not contain the TAF part.
prefix: The marketplace web profile is a side app, and side apps do not contain the TAF part.

text: The TAF check works only when TAF itself sends the code to the phone that types it.
prefix: The TAF check works only when TAF itself sends the code to the phone that types it.

text: So in a side app, on a phone or on the web, the bank's own SMS service always sends the code.
prefix: So in a side app, on a phone or on the web, the bank's own SMS service always sends the code.

text: Aziz reads the code on his phone and types it on his laptop.
prefix: Aziz reads the code on his phone and types it on his laptop.

text: The platform compares it with the digest.
prefix: The platform compares it with the digest.

text: They match, so the record moves to Number verified, and the code is void.
prefix: They match, so the record moves to Number verified, and the code is void.

text: There is no verdict on the web.
prefix: There is no verdict on the web.

text: The audit event simply says that the source was web.
prefix: The audit event simply says that the source was web.

text: Now one rule that I think every identity team should copy.
prefix: Now one rule that I think every identity team should copy.

text: Until the number is verified, the platform makes nothing for it: no consent, no device record, no session.
prefix: Until the number is verified, the platform makes nothing for it: no consent, no device record, no session.

text: A request that tries gets one answer: number not verified.
prefix: A request that tries gets one answer: number not verified.

text: Next, the platform looks up the number.
prefix: Next, the platform looks up the number.

text: It belongs to nobody, so this is a new person.
prefix: It belongs to nobody, so this is a new person.

text: The marketplace asks Aziz for a password, and then for the same password a second time.
prefix: The marketplace asks Aziz for a password, and then for the same password a second time.

text: Aziz types two different words by mistake, and the platform refuses: the two entries are not the same.
prefix: Aziz types two different words by mistake, and the platform refuses: the two entries are not the same.

text: He tries again.
prefix: He tries again.

text: This time the password is long enough, it is not on the list of common and breached passwords, and it does not contain his phone number.
prefix: This time the password is long enough, it is not on the list of common and breached passwords, and it does not contain his phone number.

text: Nobody asks him for a symbol or a capital letter.
prefix: Nobody asks him for a symbol or a capital letter.

text: Lesson 13 shows how the platform keeps it.
prefix: Lesson 13 shows how the platform keeps it.

text: Now four things appear at once.
prefix: Now four things appear at once.

text: A customer at level one.
prefix: A customer at level one.

text: An app account in the marketplace.
prefix: An app account in the marketplace.

text: A device record for the browser, which can never become trusted.
prefix: A device record for the browser, which can never become trusted.

text: And a session for this browser.
prefix: And a session for this browser.

text: The registration record is now Onboarded.
prefix: The registration record is now Onboarded.

text: The marketplace needs only level one to keep a wish list, so Aziz uses it at once.
prefix: The marketplace needs only level one to keep a wish list, so Aziz uses it at once.

text: On Monday morning, Aziz installs the mobile bank on his phone, and types the same number.
prefix: On Monday morning, Aziz installs the mobile bank on his phone, and types the same number.

text: This time the code goes another way.
prefix: This time the code goes another way.

text: The mobile bank is the master app, so the platform sends the code through TAF.
prefix: The mobile bank is the master app, so the platform sends the code through TAF.

text: TAF sends the SMS, and its part inside the app checks that the code arrived on this phone, with this SIM card.
prefix: TAF sends the SMS, and its part inside the app checks that the code arrived on this phone, with this SIM card.

text: If TAF does not answer, the bank's SMS service sends the code instead, and Lesson 12 shows what that costs.
prefix: If TAF does not answer, the bank's SMS service sends the code instead, and Lesson 12 shows what that costs.

text: Aziz types the code, and the number is verified again.
prefix: Aziz types the code, and the number is verified again.

text: But now the number belongs to a customer: Aziz himself, from Sunday.
prefix: But now the number belongs to a customer: Aziz himself, from Sunday.

text: So this is not a registration.
prefix: So this is not a registration.

text: The platform does not show the existing account.
prefix: The platform does not show the existing account.

text: It asks for the same password, the one from Sunday.
prefix: It asks for the same password, the one from Sunday.

text: Then it continues as a login from a new device, and it adds an app account for the mobile bank.
prefix: Then it continues as a login from a new device, and it adds an app account for the mobile bank.

text: Still one person, one number, one password.
prefix: Still one person, one number, one password.

text: What if the person on Monday did not know that password?
prefix: What if the person on Monday did not know that password?

text: Then the only way forward is a password reset, never a second account.
prefix: Then the only way forward is a password reset, never a second account.

text: And if the number belonged to a blocked customer, the journey stops with one sentence: Please contact the bank.
prefix: And if the number belonged to a blocked customer, the journey stops with one sentence: Please contact the bank.

text: One more case.
prefix: One more case.

text: A registration that never reaches level one does not wait forever.
prefix: A registration that never reaches level one does not wait forever.

text: After the configured time, the record expires.
prefix: After the configured time, the record expires.

text: The platform deletes its data and keeps only the audit events.
prefix: The platform deletes its data and keeps only the audit events.

text: A new try starts from the beginning.
prefix: A new try starts from the beginning.

text: To recap.
prefix: To recap.

text: The app sends the number.
prefix: The app sends the number.

text: The platform opens a record, and makes a random code that it keeps only as a digest.
prefix: The platform opens a record, and makes a random code that it keeps only as a digest.

text: The master app gets its code through TAF, and every side app through the bank's SMS service.
prefix: The master app gets its code through TAF, and every side app through the bank's SMS service.

text: A verified number then becomes a new customer at level one, or a login for a customer who already exists.
prefix: A verified number then becomes a new customer at level one, or a login for a customer who already exists.

text: But look at Sunday evening again.
prefix: But look at Sunday evening again.

text: The code went to a number that anyone can type.
prefix: The code went to a number that anyone can type.

text: What stops a stranger from asking for codes all night, or from guessing one?
